title: Kanmani Anbudan
episodeTitle: Rajeshwari Asks Anbu to Resume Work
description: Anbu narrates his love story to Maya and Iniyan as a bedtime tale. Following Senthil's missed profitable order, Rajeshwari urges Anbu to resume managing the company.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Sidharth drives Nalani out on their wedding night, but she boldly stands against him with Ilamathi's guidance. Later, Paraman shares a romantic moment with Ilamathi.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Overcome by guilt, Vetri kneels before Abinaya for forgiveness, but she refuses. Furious over the verdict, Swetha decides to hold off on marrying Karna until Abinaya is punished.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi assures Manjamalai that her injury was accidental. Influenced by Rasathi, Manjamalai approaches the police to complain that Mayandi's family is harassing Poongodi.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Rajeev's men attack Cheran's brothers as his family arrives in Bihar, but he fights back fiercely. Despite the engagement celebrations, the family feels distressed by the clash.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Muthu Steps in for Emergency Care
description: Muthu and Ravi joyfully prepare for their wedding night with their wives. Later, Muthu steps forward to support his friend's son's emergency treatment after an accident.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: At the panchayat, Tamizhselvi initially refuses to hold the ear-piercing ceremony publicly. Hearing both families' wishes, she agrees on condition that she shares the expenses.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karikalan and his mother firmly refuse to accept Kasturi as Karthik's wife. Karthik stands firm, refusing to enter the house unless Kasturi is welcomed.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Due to his stinginess, Kandhasamy convinces his family to eat Upma made from leftover wedding Idlis. Indhira cleverly transforms them into delicious Idli biryani and earns praise.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: A Game of Blind Football
description: 22 contestants split into three teams for Blind Football and a supermarket task. Hilarious stories, team guidance, and an argument with Muniyamma lead to dramatic star ratings.
